lead: Retro tokusatsu monster movie still, giant monsters and robots, miniature city at dusk, red and yellow glow.
notes: Mood-only mini images for colossal_devastators.html, beside the lore, game layer and feature text. SDXL (free): gen colossal-mini --model sdxl --max 999, then finish colossal-mini --model sdxl. Each prompt is the section's opening line; the images add flavor and never try to show a mechanic accurately.

images.name: show
images.prompt: An alien mothership hovering over a city as a giant monster descends from it.

images.name: locals
images.prompt: A column of army tanks and helicopters rolling toward a giant shadow in the smoke.

images.name: stomp
images.prompt: A giant robot foot stepping down onto a city street between tall buildings.
